words: Small-town FiveM roleplay with big stories. Serious RP, whitelisted departments, 18+.
Every department is run by players, with ranks, training and real responsibility.
Tap the pins on the map to explore the county.
Pick a department. The question changes with it.
will message you on Discord within two days.
Out-of-character chat goes in /ooc, briefly. Everything else is your character speaking.
Pickups don't jump canyons. Drive like your car and your life matter.
Robberies and feuds need build-up. Talk before you shoot, and always value your life.
No one patrols alone until they pass academy. It keeps scenes fair for everyone.

Open FiveM, press F8 and paste this:
A driver won't stop for you on Route 9 at night. What do you do, step by step?
You arrive first at a crash with two injured drivers. Who do you help first, and why?
Three calls come in at once: a fight, a fire and a stolen tractor. How do you route them?
A storm closes the only bridge into town. What's your plan for the next hour?
Describe your character's family and the one secret they keep from the town.
